label: Run 11 · all 3 chats
note: Every chat of run 11 (each comedian's own brief; both characters in one short take; the chat set up and paid off): the same pair, the same brief and the same prompt, each written by a different writer.

chat.variety.why: All three chats play the same scene in the same order. A lie or a disclosure opens, Brick calls out the act, they swap flaws, Reuben confesses he rehearses, they trade exes, and it ends on a timed sex itinerary sent as a calendar invite. Booster and Carr share the opening move (Reuben tips the top hat, Brick clocks the four-second reply). Many lines recur across all three: the four seconds, the cab-sobbing over "let's do this again", the Google Calendar fights, and "ten seconds" of silence making Reuben disappear. Small differences keep it off a 1: Ali Wong opens with Brick and has Reuben write the itinerary, and Carr ends on the response-time twist.

chat.variety.raise: Break the shared spine: give at least one chat a different turning point and an ending that is not a timed itinerary, and cut the stock profile lines (cab sobbing, shared calendar, dishwasher-safe) that each writer copied wholesale.
